purpose: Teach: 文藝春秋/自営業/発刊/主将/関心事/講堂/ブレーク/学識

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、文藝春秋社の編集者と懇談しろ
lines.en: Get in touch with an editor from Bungei-Shunju and have a detailed discussion.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Rapid-fire delivery. Each word lands like a directive. No warmth, no room for negotiation. Hiroshi at his most businesslike.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様の自営業者の方々を集めた会を計画しております
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'm currently organizing a gathering of our valued self-employed clients.
lines.style: Respectful, steady cadence. Kenji affirms crisply, then shifts into detail mode—measured, thorough, professional. The tone of someone who has prepared his answer.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新雑誌の発刊予定を発表しろ
lines.en: Announce our new magazine's publication schedule to the company.
lines.style: Direct command. Hiroshi's voice is lean and purposeful. No preamble. The authority sits naturally in the syntax, not the volume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。野球部の主将に表彰式で挨拶してもらいます
lines.en: Yes, sir. We've arranged for the baseball team captain to give the opening remarks at the award ceremony.
lines.style: Kenji responds with the same even tempo, no hesitation. Clear confirmation, then the supporting detail flows out in practiced order. Slightly formal tone befitting a company address.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お客様の関心事を把握しろ
lines.en: Make sure we understand what our customers actually care about.
lines.style: Hiroshi's tone sharpens. Less a suggestion, more a correction disguised as direction. Deliberate pause before the final phrase—emphasis on the real ask beneath the words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新本社の講堂を社内行事で活用します
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll put our new headquarters auditorium to use for internal company events.
lines.style: Kenji maintains his professional composure, but there's a subtle awareness here—he's showing Hiroshi they've already thought this through. Calm, competent delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界をブレークさせる新製品を出せ
lines.en: Launch a breakthrough product that reshapes the industry.
lines.style: This is the big one. Hiroshi's voice carries quiet intensity. No rush—each word sits with weight. The kind of command that hangs in the air after he speaks.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の学識を社外発表で生かします
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll make sure our employees' expertise is showcased in external presentations.
lines.style: Final acknowledgment. Kenji delivers this with settled confidence—he's heard the mandate and he's already envisioning execution. Slight note of closure in his cadence.
